title: Price Drop Adjustments and Competitor Price Matches, Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Rule.** When Northgate lowers its own selling price on an item, or a competitor on the program's list offers the identical item in stock at a lower price, **Northgate Store and Online Orders** refunds the customer the difference on the units still held.

**Time gate.** A price adjustment or match is granted only when it is requested no later than the order date plus the program's price adjustment window days. The clock starts from the order date in the system record of that order. Calendar days are added to the order date, the day after the order being day 1, and a request on the last day still qualifies.

| Hypothetical case (14-day window, order dated 5 May) | Request date | Granted |
|---|---|---|
| last day | 19 May | yes |
| day after | 20 May | no |

**Qualifying prices.** The lower price must be a regular or advertised price available to every customer; the program's excluded offers are never matched, and Northgate Marketplace seller offers are never used. The competitor item must be identical and in stock as the program requires.

**Once per line.** Each order line may be adjusted only once, whichever kind of adjustment is used first; this follows the program's most adjustments per line.

**Amount.** The refund is the line's net unit price before the cardholder discount less the lower unit price, multiplied by the units still held (units bought less units returned or refunded); where the line was paid with a Northgate Card the refund is reduced by the cardholder discount percentage so that it reflects what was actually paid. It is rounded half up to the cent and credited to the tender that paid the line, following the program's refund basis. Northgate Cash already earned on the line is not changed.

**Limits.** No adjustment is made on units already returned, or on an order not yet fulfilled, which instead is charged the price at fulfilment.

**Hypothetical amount.** A line of 3 units at a net unit price of 40.00 before the cardholder discount, with 1 unit returned and a matched price of 34.00, paid by an external card, refunds 6.00 on each of the 2 units held: 12.00.
